claims.claim: Provider-neutral native execution policy now provides a 60-minute response budget and an exact 65-minute process watchdog for mutation and read-only executions.
Antigravity uses the 60-minute native response deadline, 65-minute outer watchdog, and policy-derived timeout reporting.
Codex PRIMARY, REMEDIATION, and REPAIR paths use the 65-minute outer watchdog and policy-derived 60-minute timeout reporting.
Deterministic adapter regressions cover immediate acceptance of successful early native returns without minimum-duration waiting.
The implementation is limited to execution-ceiling policy, adapter timeout handling, and direct regression coverage; dispatch, verification ownership, and retry/fallback semantics remain unchanged.
